results.title: Industrial Estate 48
results.author: Thomas_Bey_William_Bailey
results.description: From a pack of samples created with my modular system and optimized for use in Ableton Live. The "Industrial Estate" loops make generous use of metal percussion, analog drum machines, 'micro-sound' techniques, tape manipulation / digital 'scrubbing', and RF signals. Ideal for recycling into abrasive or intense compositions across all genres of electronic music.
